premises.text: Presentation work is fragmented across desktop apps, email, chat, and file stores, breaking formatting and requiring yet another tool to present or share
premises.evidence_span: people are creating their presentation in PowerPoint, sharing it via email, having a conversation about it on Slack

premises.text: Slides is an end-to-end cloud platform for creating, presenting, and sharing with a new stacked-detail format and collaborative customizable editor
premises.evidence_span: Slides is an end-to-end platform for creating, presenting, and sharing presentations

premises.text: Teams use shared templates and in-editor media libraries so creators focus on content instead of design tooling elsewhere
premises.evidence_span: This allows Jack to focus on his content instead of designing his slides

premises.text: Present live with speaker notes, export offline, or share a link—including richly interactive slides on phones and tablets
premises.evidence_span: we can choose to either present live from slides.com using speaker notes, export and present offline, or simply share the presentation as a link

premises.text: Monetization spans free signup, individual and team plans, and Enterprise behind the corporate firewall for security
premises.evidence_span: Everyone can sign up for free and create presentations. We offer plans for individuals and teams like Acme, and we're really excited because we just started rolling out Slides for Enterprise

value.text: Make it easy for teams to work together on presentations end-to-end
value.evidence_span: We make it easy to work together on presentations

causal_links.evidence_span: we've actually changed the way teams work together on presentations
if you're ready to create better presentations, sign up now at Slides.com

notes: Demo feature list (3D embed, comments, grid) folded into end-to-end platform (v1.3.2 §4.1(5)). User/visitor traction excluded. Pricing/Enterprise singleton retained as separately revisable commercial module. Need/product/money triad justified.
